_: Footage windows on 38-compute (defaults, no at=/sa=/sb= overrides). Rects are the FOOTAGE AREA in stage pixels at 1920x1080 (double every value for the 4K render). The page draws a 2 px cream frame just OUTSIDE each rect, so footage cropped exactly to the rect sits inside it. Times are seconds from the page's first frame (page 0 = VO 209.6); frames at 30 fps. Render the edit's copy with slots=0 so each window is a flat dark ground (#050507) for the footage to cover. Never two windows at once.
wipe: Opening: eased (cubic in-out) over 'opening'; the window first grows as a 2 px horizontal line from its centre out to full width, then opens vertically from its centre line to full height. Closing is the reverse over 'closing' (A 0.12 s, B 0.22 s). Simplest composite: cut the footage in at visible_open.in and out at visible_open.out (the window shows its dark ground during the wipes). To ride the wipe instead, crop the footage to the same centre-out rectangle.

overrides: sa=open,close and sb=open,close on the page query move the windows (open = wipe start, close = wipe end; visible_open = [open+0.28, close-0.12] for A and [open+0.28, close-0.22] for B). Keep A's visible time <= 2.47 s and B's <= 3.83 s, and B's open >= A's close. If you change them, recompute this file's times the same way.
